findings.title: Converted config copy is discarded, raw config returned
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context a copy of the monitor config is made and schedule_type is converted to its display value, but the returned dict uses monitor_environment.monitor.config instead of the converted local variable config. The conversion is therefore dead code and the occurrence context carries the raw schedule_type value instead of the intended human-readable display value.
